Attached: 1 image

A vulnerability in Docker Hub, tracked as CVE-2026-105445 and named GhostPat, allowed unauthorized users to push, pull, or delete container images as other users.

The flaw existed in the account conversion feature, which incorrectly transferred personal access tokens to designated organization owners.
